title: Origin story: Vespera
description: Vespera was a mapmaker's apprentice who noticed that maps drawn at dusk showed places that did not exist at noon. She began charting the dusk-lands — the world as it is between day and night — and found she could walk into her own maps. She now maps the hour itself, and her charts are the only guides through twilight's country.

title: Ability profile: Vespera
description: Ranked abilities: Cartography — rank 100/100; Twilight navigation — rank 98/100; Draftsmanship — rank 97/100; Perception — rank 95/100; Courage — rank 90/100.

title: Power ranking: Vespera
description: Powers: Her maps are doors — walk the line, arrive the place; She sees the dusk-layer over the day world; Twilight obeys her compass.

title: Stamina feats: Vespera
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Mapped for thirty years of dusks; Walked out of a map that tried to keep her.

title: Crossover notes: Vespera
description: Vespera crosses naturally with: twilight, maps, the in-between hours.

title: Design notes: Vespera
description: The map as doorway; the hour between as a country.
